exams.name: Real Estate Broker Examination
exams.notes: Written, electronic or other examination method; must be proctored in person. Applicants holding a current real estate license in another state are exempt from the national portion per section 32-4302. The broker exam must be more exacting and stringent and of broader scope than the salesperson exam.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by Arizona Real Estate Department/Commissioner)
exams.quote: The commissioner shall ascertain by a written, electronic or other examination method that an applicant for a real estate license has: 1. period_years.quote: The total number of credit hours shall be accrued at a rate of twenty-four credit hours for salespersons and associate brokers and thirty credit hours for designated brokers or for associate brokers employed by a designated broker pursuant to section 32-2151.01, subsection G during each twenty-four-month period of licensure.

title_protection.quote: Knowingly used the term "real estate broker", "cemetery broker" or "membership camping broker" without the legal right to do so.

scope_protection.quote: A person who acts as a broker or salesperson within the meaning of this chapter, or who advertises in a manner that indicates that the person is licensed as a broker or salesperson, without being licensed as prescribed by this chapter is guilty of a class 6 felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursued a course of misrepresentation or made false promises, directly or through others, whether acting as licensee or principal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursued a course of misrepresentation or made false promises, either directly or through others, whether acting in the role of a licensee or a principal in a transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acted for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge or written consent of all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acted for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge or written consent of all parties to the transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarded or violated any provisions of this chapter or rules adopted by the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disregarded or violated any of the provisions of this chapter or any rules adopted by the commissioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly authorized or aided in publication of false or misleading statements concerning the licensee's business or any land or subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly authorized, directed, connived at or aided in the publication, advertisement, distribution or circulation of any material false or misleading statement or representation concerning the licensee's business or any land, cemetery property, subdivision or membership campground or camping contract offered for sale in this or any other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly used the term 'real estate broker' without the legal right to do so.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly used the term "real estate broker", "cemetery broker" or "membership camping broker" without the legal right to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed any unlicensed salesperson or unlicensed associate broker.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employed any unlicensed salesperson or unlicensed associate broker.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepted compensation from a person not authorized to provide it under section 32-2155.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepted compensation as a licensee for performing any of the acts specified in this chapter from any person who is not authorized to provide compensation pursuant to section 32-2155.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Represented or attempted to represent a broker other than the broker to whom the salesperson or associate broker is licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Represented or attempted to represent a broker other than the broker to whom the salesperson or associate broker is licensed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed within a reasonable time to account for or remit monies or surrender documents belonging to others.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed, within a reasonable time, to account for or to remit any monies, to surrender to the rightful owner any documents or other valuable property that comes into the licensee's possession and that belongs to others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paid or received any rebate, profit, compensation or commission in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paid or received any rebate, profit, compensation or commission in violation of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Induced any party to break a contract for the purpose of substituting a new contract motivated by personal gain.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Induced any party to a contract to break the contract for the purpose of substituting a new contract with the same or a different principal, if the substitution is motivated by the personal gain of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placed a sign on any property offering it for sale or rent without the written authority of the owner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placed a sign on any property offering it for sale or for rent without the written authority of the owner or the owner's authorized agent.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicited prospects through promotions of a speculative nature involving games of chance or lotteries not authorized under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicited, either directly or indirectly, prospects for the sale, lease or use of real property, cemetery property or membership camping contracts through a promotion of a speculative nature involving a game of chance or risk or through conducting lotteries or contests that are not specifically authorized under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay the commissioner the renewal fee as specified in this chapter promptly and before the time specified.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to pay to the commissioner the renewal fee as specified in this chapter promptly and before the time specified.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to keep an escrow or trust account or other record of monies deposited relating to a real estate transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to keep an escrow or trust account or other record of monies deposited with the licensee relating to a real estate transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingled the monies or other property of the licensee's principal or client with the licensee's own or converted these monies.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingled the monies or other property of the licensee's principal or client with the licensee's own or converted these monies or property to the licensee or another.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed or refused on demand to produce any document, contract, book, record or report for inspection by the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed or refused on demand to produce any document, contract, book, record, information, compilation or report that is in the licensee's possession or that the licensee is required by law to maintain concerning any real estate, cemetery or membership camping business, services, activities or transactions involving or conducted by the licensee for inspection by the commissioner or the commissioner's representative.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to maintain a complete record of each transaction that comes within this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to maintain a complete record of each transaction that comes within this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated the federal fair housing law, the Arizona civil rights law or any local ordinance of a similar nature.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated the federal fair housing law, the Arizona civil rights law or any local ordinance of a similar nature.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Tendered to a buyer a wood infestation report knowing that wood infestation exists or that the report was inaccurate or false.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Tendered to a buyer a wood infestation report in connection with the transfer of residential real property or an interest in residential real property knowing that wood infestation exists or that the wood infestation report was inaccurate or false as of the date of the tender or that an inspection was not done in conjunction with the preparation of the wood infestation report.

disciplinary_grounds.description: As a licensed broker, failed to exercise reasonable supervision over the activities of salespersons, associate brokers or others under the broker's employ.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: As a licensed broker, failed to exercise reasonable supervision over the activities of salespersons, associate brokers or others under the broker's employ or failed to exercise reasonable supervision and control over the activities for which a license is required of a corporation, limited liability company or partnership on behalf of which the broker acts as designated broker under section 32-2125.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated negligence in performing any act for which a license is required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demonstrated negligence in performing any act for which a license is required.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sold or leased a property to a buyer or lessee that was not the property represented.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sold or leased a property to a buyer or lessee that was not the property represented to the buyer or lessee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any condition or term of a commissioner's order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any condition or term of a commissioner's order.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signed the name of another person on any document or form without the express written consent of the person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signed the name of another person on any document or form without the express written consent of the person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured or attempted to procure a license by fraud, misrepresentation or deceit or by filing a false or misleading application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procured or attempted to procure a license under this chapter for the holder or applicant or another by fraud, misrepresentation or deceit or by filing an original or renewal application that is false or misleading.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been convicted of a felony or of any crime of forgery, theft, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, a crime of moral turpitude or any other like offense.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction in this or any other state of a felony or of any crime of forgery, theft, extortion, conspiracy to defraud, a crime of moral turpitude or any other like offense.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made any substantial misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made any substantial misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Made any false promises of a character likely to influence, persuade or induce.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Been guilty of any conduct that constitutes fraud or dishonest dealings.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been guilty of any conduct, whether of the same or a different character than specified in this section, that constitutes fraud or dishonest dealings.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the business of a real estate broker or salesperson without holding a license as prescribed in this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaged in the business of a real estate broker, cemetery broker or membership camping broker or real estate salesperson, cemetery salesperson or membership camping salesperson without holding a license as prescribed in this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated incompetence to perform any duty or requirement of a licensee under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Demonstrated incompetence to perform any duty or requirement of a licensee under or arising from this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated the terms of any criminal or administrative order, decree or sentence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated the terms of any criminal or administrative order, decree or sentence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any federal or state law or regulation relating to real estate or securities or involving forgery, theft, extortion, fraud, or dishonest dealings.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated any federal or state law, regulation or rule that relates to real estate or securities or that involves forgery, theft, extortion, fraud, substantial misrepresentation, dishonest dealings or violence against another person or failure to deal fairly with any party to a transaction that materially and adversely affected the transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to respond in the course of an investigation or audit by providing documents or written statements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failed to respond in the course of an investigation or audit by providing documents or written statements.

bonding_required.quote: any subdivider prior to the sale or lease of any existing unimproved lots or parcels and any subdivider who is subsequently required to give notice under section 32-2181 or 32-2195 or who petitions for exemption under section 32-2181.01 may be required to post a surety bond with the commissioner

definition_quote.value: Real estate broker means a person, other than a salesperson, who, for another and for compensation: (a) Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents or leases real estate, businesses and business opportunities or timeshare interests. (b) Offers to sell, exchange, purchase, rent or lease real estate, businesses and business opportunities or timeshare interests. (c) Negotiates or offers, attempts or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, rental or leasing of real estate, businesses and business opportunities or timeshare interests...
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker" means a person, other than a salesperson, who, for another and for compensation: (a) Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents or leases real estate, businesses and business opportunities or timeshare interests.

exam_application_window_years.quote: Any person who has passed the state examination for broker or salesperson must become licensed within one year from the date of the examination.

inactive_license_max_years.quote: if the license has been inactive for more than fifteen years, the commissioner shall require that the applicant successfully pass an examination specific to the laws of this state relating to this chapter before activating the license.

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: not had a license revoked within the two years immediately preceding application in this state pursuant to section 32-2153 or a similar statute in any other state.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: Acted for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge or written consent of all parties to the transaction.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A real estate employment agreement is not required for a licensee to represent a party in a transaction.

Purchaser's right to receive a copy of the public report

sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: All agreements and contracts for the purchase or lease of subdivided land from a subdivider, owner or agent shall clearly and conspicuously disclose, in accordance with regulations adopted by the commissioner, the nature of the document, the purchaser's right to receive a copy of the public report and, in the case of unimproved lots or parcels not exempted by regulation pursuant to section 32-2185.01, the purchaser's right to rescind the agreement

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Have a definite duration or expiration date, showing dates of inception and expiration.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: The records of each transaction and employment records shall be kept by the broker for a period of at least five years after the date of the termination of the transaction or employment.

escrow_account_required.quote: any licensed real estate broker who does not immediately place all monies entrusted to the broker, in the broker's capacity as a real estate broker, in a neutral escrow depository in this state shall on receipt place all such monies in a trust fund account in a federally insured or guaranteed account in a depository located in this state.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: This section does not allow a broker to commingle monies entrusted to the broker with the broker's own monies, unless the commissioner adopts rules that allow commingling.

fixed_office_required.quote: Each employing broker shall have and maintain a definite place of business or an active and valid statutory agent on file with the corporation commission.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: Each branch office shall be under the management of a broker or a licensed salesman.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A broker shall employ and pay only active licensees, and a licensee shall accept employment and compensation as a licensee only from either or both of the following: 1. The legally licensed broker to whom the licensee is licensed.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: An employing broker may engage the services of salespersons and associate brokers who act through and on behalf of professional corporations or professional limited liability companies that are licensed by the department.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The commissioner shall establish and maintain a real estate recovery fund for the benefit of any person aggrieved by any act, representation, transaction or conduct of a licensed real estate or cemetery broker or real estate or cemetery salesperson that violates this chapter or the rules adopted pursuant to this chapter.

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: Thirty thousand dollars for each transaction, regardless of the number of persons aggrieved or the number of licensees or parcels of real estate involved.

recovery_fund_max_per_licensee.quote: Ninety thousand dollars for each licensee.

promotional_land_sales_registration_requ.quote: Before offering subdivided lands for sale or lease, the subdivider shall notify the commissioner in writing of the subdivider's intention.

wholesale_transaction_cancellation_right.quote: Any contract or agreement entered into after January 1, 1977, to purchase or lease an unimproved lot or parcel may be rescinded by the purchaser without cause of any kind by sending or delivering written notice of rescission by midnight of the seventh calendar day following the day on which the purchaser or prospective purchaser has executed such contract or agreement.
